name: Konami VRC7

components.role: VRC7 ASIC with PRG/CHR banking, CIRAM routing, SRAM gate, IRQ and FM register decode
Reusable Konami VRC 8-bit reload/counter and 341-dot scanline prescaler circuitry
Chip-local six-channel two-operator FM digital generator with custom and mask-ROM instruments

connections: mapper.ChrBank0..7 -> ChrMemory (ROM or RAM) bank address inputs
notes: Mapper 85 VRC7. The package accepts documented x008/x010 register aliases while keeping $9010/$9030 dedicated to the FM address/data ports. CHR memory may be banked ROM or banked writable RAM as declared by the cartridge image; mixed ROM/RAM remains rejected pending a verified board topology. Expansion audio remains cartridge-local until a generic analog cartridge path is modeled.
